title: Chronicler Engine Settings
description: Application settings for Chronicler Engine including LLM connections and text check configuration.

connections.description: LLM API connections available to the engine.

api_key.description: Optional API key. Falls back to environment variable if omitted.

base_url.description: Optional custom base URL for the provider API.

single_user_message.description: Whether to combine system + user into a single user message.

max_context_tokens.description: Optional maximum context window size in tokens.

narration_connection_id.description: Connection ID to use for narrative generation. Must reference an entry in connections.

quantifier_connection_id.description: Connection ID to use for the quantifier/parser. Must reference an entry in connections.

response_length.description: Guideline for the narrator on response length and pacing.

text_check.description: Configuration for the text check (spell/grammar) feature.

enable_auto_check.description: Whether to automatically check text before sending.

ignored_words.description: List of words to ignore during text checking.

agents.description: Agent configurations. A non-empty list registers exactly the agents it names; an empty list falls back to the built-in defaults.

backend.description: Which LLM connection serves this agent.

type.description: use_main reuses the narration recorder; use_named looks up a named recorder.

value.description: Recorder name, required when type is use_named.

phase.description: Pipeline position where the agent runs.

mode_preset_registry.description: Per-narrator-mode default preset bundles. The list may be partial; a missing mode falls back to constructed defaults.

mode.description: Narrator mode this bundle applies to.

system_prompt_preset_id.description: System prompt preset for this mode.

quantifier_prompt_preset_id.description: Quantifier prompt preset for this mode.

impersonate_prompt_preset_id.description: Impersonation prompt preset for this mode.

active_options_prompt_preset_id.description: ID of the active options prompt preset.
